post.description:
Mark onboarding done and ask for the two background passes over the answers.

Both handlers belong to other slices; this only enqueues them, in the same
transaction as the change, so neither can run for an onboarding that rolled back.
Create the thread, and — for someone coming back — its opening line.

schema.title: Response List Invites Api V1 Admin Invites Get

Accepted.title: Accepted
Accepted.description: 202 body for work that finished later, or that deliberately says nothing.

AssertionOut.title: AssertionOut
AssertionOut.description: A correction, kept as the bare claim it is.

ConfidenceView.title: ConfidenceView
ConfidenceView.description: How sure KnoRI is, and the same thing said in words.

ConversationEventOut.title: ConversationEventOut
ConversationEventOut.description: A Recognition card placed in the thread, after ``after_seq``.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when this is the end.

CorrectionEffectView.title: CorrectionEffectView
CorrectionEffectView.description: What one piece of feedback changed — the "what changed" panel.

is_incognito.title: Is Incognito
is_incognito.description: Incognito conversations are never extracted from.

EvidenceGroups.title: EvidenceGroups
EvidenceGroups.description: Contradicting evidence keeps its own group; it is never mixed in.

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description: One provenance row: the user's own words, and how to get back to them.

FeedbackAccepted.title: FeedbackAccepted
FeedbackAccepted.description: 202: the card already moved; the durable effects are still being worked out.

InterpretationView.title: InterpretationView
InterpretationView.description: The engine's current reading behind the card ("Technical details").

MemorySourceOut.title: MemorySourceOut
MemorySourceOut.description: The message a memory came from, and the words in it.

opener.title: Opener
opener.description: KnoRI's first line, or null for a first-ever conversation.

OnboardingStateOut.title: OnboardingStateOut
OnboardingStateOut.description:
Derived from the data, never from a separate progress column.

Step 1 is done when a preferred name exists, step 2 when a legal acceptance row
exists, step 3 when all scripted questions have an answer. Nothing can drift.

ProfileOut.title: ProfileOut
ProfileOut.description: "How KnoRI sees you" — regenerated, never edited by hand.

RecognitionCard.title: RecognitionCard
RecognitionCard.description: What a tab shows. Enough to render the card without a second request.

RecognitionDetail.title: RecognitionDetail
RecognitionDetail.description: The full card, with the words behind it.

RecognitionSummary.title: RecognitionSummary
RecognitionSummary.description: Counts for the nav badge and the tab headers.

client_message_id.title: Client Message Id
client_message_id.description: Set by the browser so a retry after a dropped stream is not a second turn.

SessionOut.title: SessionOut
SessionOut.description: What the client gets after register or login. The token is in the cookie only.

UpdateMemoryItemIn.title: UpdateMemoryItemIn
UpdateMemoryItemIn.description: Any field left out is left alone. Editing the text marks the row user-edited.

WelcomeBackOut.title: WelcomeBackOut
WelcomeBackOut.description: The strip at the top of a returning visit (plan §5.5).
